`burgee/meow` is a drop-in for `meow`, graded by the incumbent's own test suite. Its API is the incumbent's, so its reference is the incumbent's own documentation.

- **Reference:** [meow 14.1.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/meow/v/14.1.0), the release that suite is run at.
- **How closely it matches:** [Compatibility](/docs/compatibility), that suite's result in CI, with every case left out of the gate and the reason.
- **Moving a program over:** [`burgee migrate`](/docs/migrate) rewrites `'meow'` to `'burgee/meow'` across a project.

## Exports

Every name `burgee/meow` exports, as the built declarations state them. Signatures and behaviour are meow's.

| Export | Kind |
| :-- | :-- |
| `default` | const |
| `AnyFlag` | type |
| `AnyFlags` | type |
| `Flag` | type |
| `FlagType` | type |
| `InputOption` | type |
| `InputOptionType` | type |
| `IsRequiredPredicate` | type |
| `Options` | type |
| `Result` | type |
| `TypedFlags` | type |
